bugs.text: Paths are arrays of 19-27 sampled points but every mover calls bez(path[0],path[1],path[2],path[3]), using the first four samples as control points: entries cover ~17% of their curve then teleport to slots, divers jump to their entry origin instead of diving at the player (divePts unused), returns snap.

Challenging stage soft-locks: enemies only move between x=-14 and -2.5 (or 238 to 226.5), off-screen and unhittable; waves only advance after 8 hits, so wave 0 respawns forever and stage 3 never ends.
startBeam and freeCaptured are never called: no tractor beam, capture, rescue or dual fighter; the whole signature mechanic is dead code.

All 40 formation enemies fire continuously (each every 150-320 frames), producing a constant bullet curtain; the play-test bot lost all ships within seconds of each start (title screen in 4-play-015s, 030s, 060s).

Sprite colours are letters ('y','b','g','r','w') that are invalid CSS colours, so sprites draw in the previous fillStyle (all white, then all purple after a Boss is hit); the 2 animation frames are identical so there is no wing flap.
drawExplosion iterates row strings as pixel objects; explosions draw nothing.
No formation sway (constant offset) and breathing only starts after all enemies are dead, i.e. never seen.
Player gets 4 ships (3 in reserve) instead of 3.
Player hitbox 10 px wide, offset right of the 7 px sprite.
Stage badge number drawn at x=226, off the 224 px canvas; one generic flag for all stages.
GAME OVER drawn twice at overlapping positions.
enemyHit sound never used; beam sound unreachable.

summary: The file is tidy at first glance (sectioned code, fixed-timestep loop, localStorage high score, correct score values, a proper title/HUD/game-over flow) and loads without errors, but almost every motion system is broken by one recurring mistake: point arrays from bezierPath/loopPath are fed back into bez() as four control points, so entries cover a fraction of their curve and teleport into place, dives never come at the player (the computed divePts is never used), and challenging-stage enemies stay off-screen while the wave counter waits for hits that cannot happen, soft-locking stage 3. The tractor beam, capture, rescue and dual fighter are dead code (startBeam and freeCaptured are never called). Sprite colours use invalid CSS colour letters, so everything draws in whatever colour was last set, wing flaps are identical frames, explosions draw nothing, the formation neither sways nor breathes, and all 40 formation enemies fire constantly, which killed the bot within seconds. It reads as a static shooting gallery under a bullet curtain rather than Galaga.
